verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core model is multi-agent orchestration. Crews are documented as collaborative groups of agents with sequential or hierarchical processes, agents can delegate tasks to coworkers, and Flows combine multiple Crews and tasks into one event-driven workflow. A hands-on community report of a multi-agent email crew corroborates this. Missing for 10: detailed evidence on hierarchical manager/handoff mechanics (the process description is truncated in the pack), and independent corroboration of delegation and Flows-level multi-crew orchestration.
